title: Family Fun Galore w/ Free Heated Pool
description:
Enjoy this multi level family home in Chandler! 2 minute walk to Pima Park, 4 mins to Downtown Chandler, 10 mins to Gilbert, 20 mins to Cubs Stadium and PHX Airport and 25 mins to Scottsdale. Enjoy restaurants, coffee shops, breakfast park, Golfland Sunsplash, Airpark Trampoline park, and more kid friendly activities! Soak up the AZ Sun in the heated pool, soccer nets, hammock, fire pit and volleyball net! Create memories in the game room-pac man, games, ping pong, popcorn and karaoke machine!
